body.estimand_functional: \(\theta_j(P)=\operatorname*{arg\,min}_{b\in\{-1,+1\}}H_{j,b}(P)\) on the identified restricted-ANM domain. On the explicit sub-half Hermite chart, the proved observable relation \(\operatorname{sign}(\mathbb E_P\psi(X_j,Y_j))=\theta_j(P)\) yields \(N_{\mathrm H}^*(d,\alpha,\lambda)\asymp\lambda^{-1}\log((d+1)/\alpha)\) unconditionally. For the larger class, only \(N^*(d,\alpha,\lambda)\gtrsim\lambda^{-1}\log((d+1)/\alpha)\) is asserted.

sampling_model.design: An i.i.d. sample \(\mathcal W_n\sim P^{\otimes n}\) from a product of \(d\) labelled bivariate laws.
sampling_model.units: Each observation contains all \(d\) supplied independent cause--effect pairs.
sampling_model.treatment: There is no designated treatment; the causal target is the orientation vector \(\theta\).
sampling_model.overlap: Each true cause and structural noise has an everywhere-positive density within one fixed Gaussian-tail envelope.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: Every nuisance fit belongs to the explicitly defined class \(\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{LP}}\): deterministic balanced four-fold rotations, degree \(\lfloor\beta\rfloor\), bandwidth \(h_n\), truncation at \(T_n\), one-sided compact-boundary kernels, ridge tie-breaking, and response clipping. The open construction must jointly prove \(\mathcal G_n(x;C_m,\widehat m)\) and orthogonalize fixed-Gaussian-kernel residual HSIC against exactly these fits.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: GENE combines neural-network explained variance with a discretized chi-square independence-test indicator in its order score; the present oracle fixed-HSIC score is only inspired by that architecture.
The directed acyclic graph becomes identifiable from the distribution under the restricted additive-noise conditions.
Regression plus independence testing is pointwise consistent under a suitable learner.
Estimated residuals require a nuisance-specific asymptotic analysis.
Observed-variable independence tests can be minimax-rate optimal against smooth local alternatives.
Permutation tests admit a general nonasymptotic minimax-power analysis.
Residual ordering and split-sample independence testing have pointwise asymptotic guarantees.
Residual-bootstrap ordering confidence sets are asymptotically valid.
Exact simultaneous recovery can exhibit a logarithmic dimension phase transition.
Observed-variable martingale HSIC has a normal calibration under independence and kernel moment conditions.

body.tldr: The unconditional field headline is a feasible-image and product-minimax result for \(d\) supplied independent cause--effect pairs: after the explicit orientation permutation \(\Pi_\theta\), a positive-density restricted-ANM Hermite chart fills \([\underline g,\overline g]^d\times\{0\}^d\times[\lambda,A_H\lambda]^d\), and legal coordinate-swapped mirrors give \(N^*(d,\alpha,\lambda)\gtrsim\lambda^{-1}\log((d+1)/\alpha)\). A matching upper frontier and confidence-set singleton transition require the explicit open construction of a second-order residual-HSIC statistic for the determinate class \(\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{LP}}\), jointly establishing the simultaneous \(L^4\) regression event \(\mathcal G_n\) and the dimension-correct threshold \(u=x+\log(2d)\), together with \(n\lambda\gtrsim\log((d+1)/\alpha)\) and \(r_n^4\lesssim\lambda\); the sample-size inequality also places \(u_{d,\alpha}\) inside the OEQ's permitted range.

project_justification.gap: Published ANM theory supplies qualitative direction identification and pointwise consistency, while published HSIC minimax theory treats observed variables. Acharya et al.'s discrete intervention experiment and Jin's linear-LiNGAM primitive-margin experiment do not determine the coupled GENE--residual-HSIC feasible image or the product exact-recovery boundary for nonlinear observational ANMs.
project_justification.niche: Independent supplied pairs isolate the exact geometry and product-testing difficulty without requiring a classification of arbitrary GENE landscapes.
project_justification.fill: The orientation-indexed permutation, scalar-coordinate Hermite expansions, attainable rectangle, and legal-mirror product converse form the unconditional contribution. The conditional upper result is pinned to \(\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{LP}}\), whose four-fold allocation, polynomial order, bandwidth, tail truncation, boundary correction, ridge rule, and clipping are fixed. Constructing the orthogonal statistic must jointly prove \(\mathcal G_n(x;C_m,\widehat m)\) and the dimension-correct \(u=x+\log(2d)\) deviation bound before the matched frontier or singleton confidence guarantee follows; the latter claims use the same event and require \(u_{d,\alpha}\le c_u n\).

body.related_work: Li et al. (2025, Equation (6) and Theorem 4.3) define the relevant hybrid score and assume a global reversal ordering; this proposal is informed by their score construction but makes no claim to sharpen their theorem on arbitrary DAGs. Peters et al. (2014, Definition 27 and Theorem 28) provide the restricted positive-density identification domain used for every positive chart point. Mooij et al. (2016, Appendix A) prove pointwise consistency of regression plus fixed-kernel HSIC under a suitable learner. Acharya et al. (2023, PMLR 206, Theorems 1.1--1.5 on pages 2--3) characterize observational--interventional sample tradeoffs for two finite-alphabet variables under discrete causal-structure identification; their interventions and total-variation margin are orthogonal to the observational nonlinear residual-HSIC product experiment. Jin (2026, arXiv:2608.15840v1, Theorem 3.1 and Equation (3.13) on page 5) proves a sharp bivariate linear-LiNGAM frontier in edge-strength, source-non-Gaussianity, and scale-uncertainty margins; that primitive-margin linear experiment is orthogonal to, rather than a substitute for, the nonlinear fixed-kernel residual-HSIC geometry here. Hl\'avka, Hu\v{s}kov\'a, and Meintanis (2011) show that estimated residuals require their own nuisance expansion; the open claim here is restricted to the fully specified four-fold class \(\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{LP}}\), including its simultaneous \(L^4\) guarantee, rather than an unspecified suitable learner. Shekhar, Kim, and Ramdas (2023, Theorems 6, 7, and 10) and Kim, Balakrishnan, and Wasserman (2022, Sections 3--7) provide observed-variable testing constructions and minimax templates. Pfister et al. (2018, Theorem E.2 and Proposition E.3) justify asymptotic residual ordering and sample splitting without the local uniform rate needed here. Wang, Kolar, and Drton (2026, JASA 121(553), 690--703, Sections 2--4) motivate inversion into causal-order confidence sets, while Gao and Stoev (2020) motivate the distinction between coordinatewise and exact simultaneous recovery. The 2026 martingale-HSIC preprint is adjacent calibration work for observed variables and is treated only as methodological context. Wornbard et al. receive non-archival credit for the presolve insight; no public theorem text under that attribution was locatable, so it is not used as a comparator.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The proposed \(\lambda^{-1}\) upper frontier is not licensed by ordinary sample splitting or by merely postulating a suitable learner. The open construction is restricted to \(\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{LP}}\) and must prove the joint event \(\mathcal G_n(x;C_m,\widehat m)\) for its fixed degree, bandwidth, truncation, boundary, clipping, and four-fold rules. It must then cancel both the first derivative and the diagonal second-order bias uniformly, turn the event's \(L^4\) error into the displayed \(r_n^4\) remainder, and pay for all \(2d\) queries through \(u=x+\log(2d)\). Failure of either the regression guarantee or the orthogonal expansion under the fixed envelope would preserve the attainable rectangle and product converse but force a slower or narrower upper frontier.
body.honest_scope: The orientation-permuted attainable rectangle, mirror-information proposition, and product-testing converse are unconditional theorem targets and form the field headline. The genuinely open construction is the joint generated-residual result for the determinate class \(\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{LP}}\): it must establish \(\mathcal G_n(x;C_m,\widehat m)\) and the residual-HSIC expansion with simultaneous \(u=x+\log(2d)\). The matching upper minimax bound requires that construction and the inequalities \(n\lambda\ge C\log((d+1)/\alpha)\) and \(r_n^4\le c_r\lambda\); the confidence-set coverage also requires \(u_{d,\alpha}\le c_u n\), and its singleton guarantee is conditional on exactly the same class, event, and signal inequalities. Acharya et al.'s discrete intervention model and Jin's linear LiNGAM model are distinct experiments, not competing answers to this nonlinear residual-HSIC question. At \(d=1\), the population rule reduces to the familiar bivariate regression--HSIC direction choice; the new content is its local margin geometry and conditional uniform rate, not a new qualitative identification rule.
